annotations.title: Send a quote request to a business

description: Send one business in the VoiceAssistants directory a request for a price quote: what the job is, when the person would like it done, and how to reach them. This sends the person's name, phone number and the job details to that business. BEFORE calling this tool, read the business's name, the job and the phone number back to the person and get a clear yes; then set `consent` to true. Only some businesses take quote requests — if this one does not, the result says so and gives its phone number instead. Read `spoken` aloud.

consent.description: Must be true: the person has just confirmed, in this conversation, that they want this business to contact them at this number.

details.description: The job in the person's own words: what is wrong or what they want done.

name.description: The person's name, as they want the business to address them.

phone.description: The phone number the business should call, with area code.

preferred_time.description: Optional: when they would like the work done, for example "this week" or "Saturday morning".

service.description: The service wanted, for example "water heater replacement".

name: request_quote
title: Send a quote request to a business
